text:
maria: Quick a11y note from review: Settings > Model tuning accordion loses keyboard focus on close. Repro: tab to header, Enter to open, tab into field, ESC closes but focus lands on body. Expected: focus returns to header.

tyler: +1. Also ensure Space works like Enter on the header button. Consider arrow-key roving between headers for dense lists.

avni: Validation errors inside the panel need to be announced. Either move focus to first invalid field on save or have an aria-live summary like "2 errors in Model tuning". Also dark theme focus ring feels too faint at 2px on #0f172a.

maria: Proposed fixes: set aria-expanded on header, add aria-controls, panel role=region with aria-labelledby, on open focus first interactive, on close focus header. Document modal-open flow (modal close returns to modal opener inside panel).

design-bot: Autocheck: "color-contrast" flagged focus outline token; fails AA at 2px on dark bg. Recommend a11y-focus-strong token or thicker outline.

sam: I'll add acceptance criteria in JIRA: 1) focus return on close, 2) aria-expanded + aria-controls, 3) panel role/labeling, 4) errors announced or focus moved, 5) optional roving keys, 6) axe + visual focus checks in dark/light.

jim: I'll pick up the frontend work. Quick Q: if an element inside the panel opens a modal, should modal close return to that opener or the accordion header? I vote return to the opener.

maria: Agreed — modal returns to opener; collapsing panel returns to header. Add both cases to test matrix.

tyler: Can we add a Storybook demo showing keyboard flow and SR cues? Makes QA easier.

sam: Yes — planning stories: "Accordion: keyboard focus return", "Accordion: error announce", "Accordion: modal opener return" plus a11y e2e for tab flow.

maria: I'll update design notes and paste a short voiceover test script for QA. Thanks!
